title: Pro-etale inverse image preserves fixed-scalar flatness
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring, $X,Y$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $g:Y\to X$ any morphism. On their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], fixed-scalar inverse image $g^*$ sends every flat sheaf of $A$-modules to a flat sheaf of $A$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Flatness is exactness of the ordinary sheaf tensor product. The coefficient and module universes are $u+1$ when the schemes have universe $u$. No etale-origin assumption is imposed.

source.place: Modules on Sites, lemma-pullback-flat (Tag 05VD); existing source instance upperStarPreservesFlat_moduleCat and its site-pullback proof

proof.text: Base change along g is representably flat and preserves pro-etale coverings. The site pullback flatness theorem applies to this base-change functor and the Noetherian coefficient ring, giving flat_sheafPullback_obj for every flat input. These functors are exactly the fixed-scalar upperStar functors. The existing source instance upperStarPreservesFlat_moduleCat implements this specialization, so this attachment creates no new proof obligation.
